method: Transfer diagnostic, with CPU clock probes in native peers. No JSON parse/serialization of payloads and no calculations. ASCII frame echoed at identical input/output byte sizes. Two fresh persistent-worker sessions, five discarded warmups, twenty samples/session/backend, alternating order. Native CPU isolates input framing/UTF-8 decode and output UTF-8 encode/write. Metadata serialization is outside those CPU intervals; wall time ends on echo receipt. This is a control, not the production protocol or a subtractable estimate for unequal Ledger input/output sizes.
